:::{#fig-mvn-bivariate-3d}

{{< include pds/_subfiles/_fig-mvn-bivariate-3d-widget.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: mvn-bivariate-3d-static
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of a bivariate Gaussian density with mean zero,
#|   variances 1 and covariance 0.8, over x1 and x2 from -3 to 3.
#|   The surface is a single bell-shaped peak of height about 0.265
#|   at the origin, stretched along the line x2 = x1
#|   and squeezed along the line x2 = -x1.
# The static view, at the example's parameter values.
mb_entries <- c(1, 0.8, 0.8, 1)
mb_covmat <- matrix(mb_entries, nrow = 2)
mb_inverse <- solve(mb_covmat)
mb_det <- det(mb_covmat)
mb_const <- 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(mb_det))
mb_x1 <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 41)
mb_x2 <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 41)
mb_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = mb_x1, x2 = mb_x2)
mb_points <- as.matrix(mb_grid)
mb_quad <- (mb_points %*% mb_inverse) * mb_points
mb_sums <- rowSums(mb_quad)
mb_dens <- mb_const * exp(-mb_sums / 2)
mb_n_x2 <- length(mb_x2)
# expand_grid() varies x2 fastest, so each row of mb_z is one x1 value,
# the layout persp() expects.
mb_z <- matrix(mb_dens, ncol = mb_n_x2, byrow = TRUE)
persp(
  mb_x1, mb_x2, mb_z,
  theta = -45, phi = 25,
  col = "#9CC3E4", border = "#0072B2",
  xlab = "x1", ylab = "x2", zlab = "density",
  ticktype = "detailed"
)
```

The [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) of $\Normal_2\paren{\vzero, \matr{\covmat}}$ in the example, with [variances](variance-covariance.qmd#def-variance) $1$ and [covariance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cov) $0.8$.
Its horizontal slices are ellipses stretched along $x_2 = x_1$.
:::
